verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document a way to attach user documents or notes as a knowledge base with grounded or cited answers over them. The memory feature describes the agent writing its own Markdown files to the workspace, and active memory is conversation-history recall; both are adjacent memory features, not user-supplied document retrieval. Workspace exec and MCP tool connections are developer building blocks and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a power user, I can attach my own documents and notes as a knowledge base and get grounded answers over them
